name: gerillass
description: Gerillass is an open-source toolkit that contains a set of Sass mixins to help designers and developers to create better, faster and consistent user interfaces.

members.name: adaptive

arguments.name: $gutter
accepts: a length subtracted from each side at every breakpoint

members.summary: Centred container whose max-width steps up at every breakpoint.

members.name: after

arguments.name: $content
accepts: a string used as the content value
a data- attribute name, rendered as attr()

members.summary: Styles the ::after pseudo-element. A `data-` argument becomes an attr() content value.

members.name: all-buttons
members.summary: Targets every button-like element at once, optionally in one pseudo-class state.

members.name: all-text-inputs
members.summary: Targets every text-like input at once, optionally in one pseudo-class state.

members.name: antialias

arguments.name: $value
accepts: "only" inside a selector to affect just that element
null for the element and its descendants

members.summary: Turns on subpixel-antialiased text smoothing.

members.name: background-dots

arguments.name: $color
accepts: one colour, or two for the diagonal variant

arguments.name: $image
accepts: an image path to sit behind the dots

members.summary: Repeating dot pattern as a background, optionally over an image.

members.name: background-image

arguments.name: $image-url
accepts: null to filter the element itself instead

arguments.name: $filter-color
accepts: one colour, or several for a gradient

arguments.name: $filter-direction
accepts: a direction name such as top or bottom-left

members.summary: Background image with an optional colour or gradient filter laid over it.

members.name: background-stripes

arguments.name: $color
accepts: one colour, or several for a multi-stripe pattern

arguments.name: $rotation
accepts: an angle; a unitless number is treated as degrees

arguments.name: $image
accepts: an image path to sit behind the stripes

members.summary: Repeating stripe pattern as a background, optionally over an image.

members.name: before

arguments.name: $content
accepts: a string used as the content value
a data- attribute name, rendered as attr()

members.summary: Styles the ::before pseudo-element. A `data-` argument becomes an attr() content value.

members.name: border-box

arguments.name: $value
accepts: "only" inside a selector to affect just that element
null for the element and its descendants

members.summary: Applies box-sizing: border-box.

members.name: border-radius

arguments.name: $args
accepts: a corner name plus a length
four lengths: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left

members.summary: Rounds corners, either all of them, one named corner, or all four individually.

members.name: brand-logo
members.summary: Logo box with an image and an accessible stretched link over it.

members.name: breakpoint

arguments.name: $params
accepts: one breakpoint name, for exactly that width
min or max plus a breakpoint
a start and an end value

members.summary: Media query built from the breakpoint map, or from raw lengths.

members.name: breakpointer

arguments.name: $selector
accepts: a selector to attach to when called at root

members.summary: Debug helper that prints the active breakpoint name into a pseudo-element.

members.name: center
members.summary: Absolutely centres an element inside its positioned parent.

members.name: circle

arguments.name: $size
accepts: a length used for both width and height

members.summary: Square element with a fully rounded border, i.e. a circle.

members.name: clearfix
members.summary: Clears floated children using an ::after pseudo-element.

members.name: columnizer

arguments.name: $params
accepts: a column count plus a gutter length
a column count plus a boolean fill flag
a column count, a gutter and a fill flag

members.summary: Flexbox grid of equal columns, with an optional gutter and fill behaviour.

members.name: counter

arguments.name: $params
accepts: a prefix, a counter style and a suffix

members.summary: CSS counter for a list, with optional text before and after the number.

members.name: ellipsis
members.summary: Truncates a single line of text with an ellipsis.

members.name: escape-to-parent
members.summary: Re-roots the current selector under another one using @at-root.

members.name: except
members.summary: Selects every sibling except the ones named.

members.name: font-face

arguments.name: $file-path
accepts: path to the files, without an extension

arguments.name: $font-style
accepts: normal, italic or oblique, or a weight number

arguments.name: $file-formats
accepts: any of eot, woff2, woff, ttf, svg

members.signature: font-face($font-family, $file-path, $font-style: normal, $font-weight: 400, $file-formats: eot woff2 woff ttf svg)
members.summary: Emits an @font-face rule for one family across several file formats. Must be called at the root.

members.name: hide
members.summary: Visually hides an element while keeping it available to screen readers, or reverses that.

members.name: linear-gradient

arguments.name: $direction
accepts: a direction name such as top or bottom-left

members.summary: Linear gradient background from a direction name or an angle.

members.name: loadify

arguments.name: $params
accepts: init at the root, or nothing
a delay, and optionally a duration, on an element

members.summary: Fades elements in on page load. Call once at the root to set up, then on each element.

members.name: only
members.summary: Selects only the siblings named.

members.name: placeholder-shown
members.summary: Styles an input while its placeholder is visible.

members.name: placeholder
members.summary: Styles the placeholder text of an input across vendor prefixes.

members.name: position

arguments.name: $offsets
accepts: one to four lengths in shorthand order, or auto/inherit/initial/0

members.summary: Sets position and offsets in one call, using shorthand order.

members.name: radial-gradient

arguments.name: $position
accepts: a position name such as center or top-left

members.summary: Radial gradient background from a shape and a position.

members.name: ratio-box
members.summary: Container that holds a fixed aspect ratio. Its single direct child is stretched to fill it.

members.name: remove

arguments.name: $params
accepts: min or max plus a breakpoint
a start and an end breakpoint

members.summary: Hides an element outright, or only within a breakpoint range.

members.name: reset-css
members.summary: Meyer reset. Must be called at the root of the stylesheet.

members.name: reset-figure
members.summary: Removes default figure margins and makes the image inside responsive.

members.name: resizable

arguments.name: $direction
accepts: a CSS resize value such as both, horizontal, vertical or none

members.summary: Makes an element user-resizable.

members.name: responsive-image
members.summary: Makes an image fill its container width.

members.name: responsive-video
members.summary: Wrapper that keeps an embedded video at a fixed aspect ratio.

members.name: scissors

arguments.name: $corners
accepts: four lengths: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left

members.summary: Cuts the corners off an element with clip-path.

members.name: screen-agent
members.summary: Media query targeting a screen pixel density.

members.name: sizer

arguments.name: $height
accepts: a length; defaults to the width

members.summary: Sets width and height together; one argument makes a square.

members.name: smartphone

arguments.name: $device
accepts: a key from $map-for-smartphones, such as iPhone11

members.summary: Media query targeting a known smartphone by device dimensions.

members.name: sprite

arguments.name: $params
accepts: an image path ending in .png, .jpg or .svg

members.summary: Sets up an element as a sprite tile: an image, a background position, or both.

members.name: stretched-link
members.summary: Expands a link to cover its positioned parent, so the whole card is clickable.

members.name: tablet

arguments.name: $device
accepts: a key from $map-for-tablets, such as iPadPro

members.summary: Media query targeting a known tablet by device dimensions.

members.name: text-gradient

arguments.name: $direction
accepts: a direction name such as top or bottom-left

members.summary: Applies a linear gradient to the text itself via background-clip.

members.name: text-image
members.summary: Fills the text with an image via background-clip.

members.name: text-selection

arguments.name: $value
accepts: "only" inside a selector to affect just that element
null for the element and its descendants

members.summary: Styles the ::selection pseudo-element.

members.name: text-shadow

arguments.name: $params
accepts: one or more groups of direction, colour and size

members.summary: Layered text shadows built from a direction, a colour and an offset.

members.name: text-stroke

arguments.name: $fallback-color
accepts: a colour for browsers without text-stroke

members.summary: Outlines text using the webkit text-stroke properties.

members.name: triangle

arguments.name: $size
accepts: one length, or two lengths as width then height

members.summary: Draws a CSS triangle out of borders, pointing in a given direction.

members.name: __clearUnit
members.summary: Strips the unit off a number, returning it unitless.

members.name: __clearWhitespace
members.summary: Removes every space from a string.

members.name: __convertToEm
members.summary: Converts a pixel length to em, against a 16px base.

members.name: __convertToNumber
members.summary: Parses a string of digits into a number.

members.name: __darken
members.summary: Mixes a colour towards black by a percentage.

members.name: __fontSizer
members.summary: Multiplies a size by a factor. Handy for a modular scale.

members.name: __fontSource

arguments.name: $file-formats
accepts: one of eot, woff2, woff, ttf, svg

members.summary: Builds one src entry for an @font-face rule.

members.name: __isColor

arguments.name: $value
accepts: a colour, or a list of colours

members.summary: Returns the value if every item in it is a colour, and errors otherwise.

members.name: __isNumber
members.summary: Returns the value if it is a number.

members.name: __isTime

arguments.name: $value
accepts: a duration such as 0.2s or 300ms, or 0

members.summary: Returns the value if it is a time in s or ms, and errors otherwise.

members.name: __lighten
members.summary: Mixes a colour towards white by a percentage.

members.name: __mapDeepGet

arguments.name: $keys
accepts: one key per level of nesting

members.summary: Reads a value out of a nested map by following a chain of keys.

members.name: __null

arguments.name: $value
accepts: a list that may contain nulls

arguments.name: $skip
accepts: true to leave nulls in place instead of using 0

members.summary: Replaces null entries in a list with 0, or drops them.

members.name: __pixelify

arguments.name: $value
accepts: a number, with or without a unit

members.summary: Returns the value with a px unit, adding one if it is missing.

members.name: __pseudoSelector

arguments.name: $pseudo
accepts: a pseudo-class name, without the colon

members.summary: Appends a pseudo-class to every selector in a list.

members.name: __remify
members.summary: Converts a pixel length to rem, against a 16px root.

members.name: __shorthandProperty
members.summary: Expands one to four values into the four-value CSS shorthand order.

members.name: __validateBreakpoint

arguments.name: $value
accepts: a key from $map-for-breakpoints, or a raw length

members.summary: Resolves a breakpoint name to its width, passing other values through.

members.name: __validateLength

arguments.name: $value
accepts: a length with a unit, or auto, inherit, initial, 0

members.summary: Returns the value if it is a length or one of auto, inherit, initial, 0.

members.name: __validateRatio
members.summary: Turns an aspect ratio into the padding-top percentage that holds it.

members.name: __validateScissors

arguments.name: $value
accepts: one to four numbers, with or without units

members.summary: Normalises corner values for the scissors mixin, adding px where missing.
